title: Run HO19 / Winflo 6 Shield product portrait

slide_intent: Use close detail to support a product claim so viewers can inspect what the claim refers to.

demonstration: A diagonal dark shoe sits beneath a black title and line of copy; lower detail crops show side construction and water droplets on the toe.
practical_value: Pair a product benefit with visible evidence while avoiding a claim that the picture proves technical performance.
